sebum_production.name: Sebum Production
sebum_production.description: Measurement of oil production from sebaceous glands
sebum_production.importance: Key indicator for acne development and treatment planning

interpretations.low: Dry skin, potential barrier issues, may need more emollients
interpretations.normal: Balanced sebum production, healthy skin function
interpretations.high: Oily skin, increased acne risk, requires sebum-regulating ingredients
interpretations.very_high: Significant acne risk, may indicate hormonal factors, needs medical evaluation

inflammation_markers.name: Inflammation Markers
inflammation_markers.description: Indicators of inflammatory processes in the skin
inflammation_markers.importance: Determines severity of inflammatory acne and treatment approach

interpretations.normal: No significant inflammation, healthy skin response
interpretations.mild: Minor inflammation, may respond to topical anti-inflammatories
interpretations.elevated: Severe inflammation, may need prescription treatment or oral medications

skin_ph.name: Skin pH Level
skin_ph.importance: Indicates skin barrier health and bacterial balance

interpretations.acidic: pH < 4.5 - May indicate irritation or over-exfoliation
interpretations.optimal: pH 4.5-5.5 - Healthy acid mantle, good barrier function
interpretations.alkaline: pH > 5.5 - Compromised barrier, bacterial overgrowth risk, acne-prone

alkaline: Restore acid mantle with pH-balanced products

hydration_level.name: Skin Hydration Level
hydration_level.description: Measurement of water content in the stratum corneum
hydration_level.importance: Affects skin barrier function and overall skin health

interpretations.very_low: Severely dehydrated, compromised barrier, increased sensitivity
interpretations.low: Dehydrated skin, needs humectants and occlusives

hydration_level.note: Dehydration can occur even in oily skin and may worsen acne

microbiome_balance.name: Skin Microbiome Balance
microbiome_balance.description: Assessment of beneficial vs harmful bacteria on skin
microbiome_balance.importance: Critical for acne development and treatment response

interpretations.balanced: Healthy diversity of beneficial bacteria, low pathogen levels
interpretations.imbalanced: Dysbiosis present, may contribute to acne or inflammation
interpretations.c_acnes_overgrowth: Excess C. acnes bacteria, acne development likely

imbalanced: Use antimicrobial ingredients (benzoyl peroxide, tea tree oil)
Avoid harsh antibacterial products that kill all bacteria
May need prescription antibiotics for severe cases

barrier_function.name: Skin Barrier Function
barrier_function.description: Assessment of skin's protective barrier integrity
barrier_function.importance: Determines skin's ability to retain moisture and protect against irritants

interpretations.excellent: Strong barrier, minimal TEWL, good protection
interpretations.severely_compromised: Significant barrier dysfunction, high sensitivity, inflammation

compromised: Avoid irritants and harsh actives temporarily

oxidative_stress.name: Oxidative Stress Markers
oxidative_stress.description: Indicators of free radical damage and antioxidant status
oxidative_stress.importance: Affects aging, inflammation, and skin health

interpretations.low: Healthy antioxidant status, minimal free radical damage
interpretations.moderate: Some oxidative stress, may benefit from antioxidants
interpretations.high: Significant oxidative stress, accelerated aging, inflammation risk
interpretations.severe: Excessive oxidative damage, requires comprehensive intervention

high: Use antioxidants (vitamin C, vitamin E, resveratrol)

hormone_indicators.name: Hormonal Indicators
hormone_indicators.description: Markers of hormonal influence on skin (indirect assessment)
hormone_indicators.importance: Critical for identifying hormonal acne and treatment planning

estrogen_fluctuation: Cyclical acne related to menstrual cycle

suspected_hormonal: May benefit from hormonal treatments (birth control, spironolactone)
Consider dietary changes (reduce dairy, manage blood sugar)
